description: Synthetic sesslint.diff parity: constants, delta rendering, path gates, import seams, and empty diff_events.
known_parity_gaps: GAP-diff-minimize-path: SessionDiff.to_dict, to_json, and render_human import sesslint.report.minimize_path in Python; Rust returns sesslint.report.minimize_path is not available.

GAP-diff-resolve-format: diff_sessions and _load_side call sesslint.adapters.detect.resolve_format once both paths are files; Rust returns sesslint.adapters.detect.resolve_format is not available and builds no SessionDiff.
GAP-diff-content-hash: diff_events with any event calls SessionEvent.content_identity_hash; Rust returns sesslint.canonical.SessionEvent is not available and discards partial deltas.
GAP-diff-schema-path: get_diff_schema_path and load_diff_schema import sesslint._resources.schema_path; Rust returns sesslint._resources.schema_path is not available.
GAP-diff-cli-integration: CLI main tests and full diff_sessions success paths are not byte-compared here.
